leadText:
Anthony (Japanese: アノキ Anoki) is a character of the day who appeared in The Punchy Pokémon. He operates the , an elite facility for Pokémon.

Anthony was his to compete in the upcoming P1 Grand Prix. He was so determined to train and win, that he was neglecting his family. His daughter, 's feelings convinced and to compete in the P1 Grand Prix to defeat him.

Ash entered using his . Anthony noticed early on that the Pig Monkey Pokémon was very strong. Anthony ended up losing in the semi-finals to and the they had stolen from , another competitor. Eventually, Ash defeated Hitmonlee in the finals and won the P1 Grand Prix. Afterwards, Anthony offered to train Primeape further, and Ash agreed.
